latest_release.name: Whiteboard 0.5.2
latest_release.body:
-- First of all, sorry about popping the toast and the update badge, its fixed in this version!

### Animations: tours, clips and previews (experimental, off by default)

  - An animation whose frames carry code gets a tour: Expand becomes Tour, and the panel and frames move together (#1483).
  - Animations paint in as they stream instead of popping in (#1483).
  - New `clip` block: one continuous timeline you play, pause and jump around by markers (#1483).
  - Scene cards can take a form (window, bars, cylinder…), an outline and a colour, so a database reads differently from a service (#1498, #1508).
  - Animations fit the board's reading width, with at least 720px of stage, and link labels avoid other lines (#1507).
  - Agents can render a frame of the animation they wrote with `session_render` and see it, instead of driving the screen (#1501).
  - Animations setting now reaches agents on remote hosts (#1495).

  ---

  ### New
  - ⌘K (Ctrl+K elsewhere) jumps to any board, PR or command; paste a GitHub PR link to open or create its board (#1493)
  - A board keeps one share link: resharing updates it in place, and receivers' copies refresh (#1477, #1527)
  - Sidebar has an Unread section; right-click or multi-select rows to mark as read (#1520)
  - Share boards that live on a remote host (#1480)
  - Boards on a live worktree can be shared as frozen, view-only snapshots; uncommitted code opens in the browser only (#1487)
  - Open files in IntelliJ IDEA at the selected line (#1514, fixes #1510 from @faysou)
  - Home rows show a remote board's host (#1526)
  - The Release notes tab lists every release and scrolls to the one you updated to (#1486)
  - Developer option `review.serviceUrl` points sign-in and sharing at another service, such as staging (#1484)

  ### Changed
  - Updates are announced only by the rex-inspired bottom-right pill. The "ready to install" and "available" toasts and the `review.update.showPill` setting are gone, and dismissing the pill hides that update in every window and
  across relaunches, if this is too annoying let us know lol (#1529)
  - Share errors say what went wrong (blocked, size or rate limit, service down, update required) instead of a generic login error (#1482)
  - Source tree is hidden on shared and hosted boards, which have no checkout (#1485, #1494)
  - Updated Electron to 43.8.6 for Chromium security fixes (#1491)
  - Shared boards open in newer Desktops even when a later version adds fields, and share peeks on new code are painted as diffs (#1470)

  ### Fixed
  - On Windows and Linux, a tour's close button and the board's page-bar buttons sat under the window controls (#1513, fixes #1490 from @batudez)
  - Remote boards didn't save typing, lost their header crumb, repository and PR state, and never resolved links; `session_get`, history, lenses and render failed for local agents (#1524)
  - A hand-made animation node lost its own position when it took a form (#1508)
  - Release notes showed `<!-- whiteboard:show-notes -->` as text (#1481)

  **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/devdotfast/whiteboard/compare/v0.5.1...v0.5.2
